newsitem.title: USA: Physiometrix's Equinox gets FDA clearance.
newsitem.headline: Physiometrix's Equinox gets FDA clearance.

text.p: Physiometrix Inc said Tuesday it had received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its Equinox EEG Neuromonitoring System.
The Equinox was a digital EEG monitoring system designed for hospitals and private-practice neurologists.

"We anticipate that the Equinox will have a significant contribution to revenues in 1997," it said. "More importantly, the Equinox is the platform for our flagship product, currently in clinical trials, the Patient State Analyzer."

The Patient State Analyzer is an early warning, analytical neuromonitoring system for use by anesthesiologists during surgery involving general anesthesia. Physiometrix, based in Boston, designs, manufactures and markets medical products for use in neurological monitoring applications.
